patterns.note: Sections are defined by full-width background color changes, creating distinct visual blocks that stack vertically.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant, classic serif font for all major headings and display text, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body copy and navigation.
A curated, earthy color palette of light beige, olive green, dark olive, and a soft lime green is used consistently to define sections and establish a refined brand identity.

As the user scrolls, the header transforms by changing the logo color and filling the CTA button. Sections reveal by sliding up into view, and elements within the hero section exhibit a subtle parallax effect relative to the main heading.
Portfolio sections utilize an asymmetrical grid layout, combining images of varying sizes to create a dynamic and editorial presentation of work.

technique_notes: The sticky header transforms on scroll: the logo color changes from a light tone to a dark tone, and the 'Contact' button transitions from an outline style to a solid fill with a contrasting text color. This can be achieved with CSS classes toggled by JavaScript based on scroll position.
Sections are revealed using a simple slide-up animation as they enter the viewport. This effect can be implemented with CSS transitions or keyframes, triggered by an Intersection Observer API.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where background images move at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth. This can be achieved using CSS transforms (translateY) on scroll, potentially enhanced by WebGL/Three.js for more complex 3D effects if present, as indicated by the detected tech.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (hero ~3x body) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text, creating a clear hierarchy with a sophisticated feel.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements, including images, buttons, and input fields, maintain crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content grids, creating an airy yet structured feel.

standout: This site stands out with its sophisticated, gallery-like presentation of content, achieved through a distinctive earthy color palette and the elegant pairing of classic serif headings with clean sans-serif body text. The subtle parallax in the hero and the transforming sticky header add a layer of refined interactivity that elevates the overall experience beyond a standard marketing site.
